hero.title:
Small actions.
Right where you click.
hero.lead: Create a file, open Terminal, or copy a folder path. A little menu bar app that puts everyday tools into Finder.
demo.label: Illustration of Clicklet actions in Finder
demo.caption: Your folder. Your next step.
what.label: What
what.title: Four useful things, one right-click.
what.body: Clicklet lives in your menu bar and adds these actions to Finder’s context menu for local files and folders.
file.detail: Create an empty file with the name you choose.
folder.detail: Make a new folder without leaving the current one.
terminal.detail: Open Terminal in that folder with one click.
path.detail: Copy the folder’s absolute path, ready to paste.
why.label: Why
why.title: Keep the small stuff small.
why.body: The next thing you need is often right beside the file you’re working with. Clicklet keeps those little steps close, so you can stay with the task.
why.native: Written in Swift. At home on your Mac.
why.native.detail: Native settings, English and Ukrainian, an optional Dock icon, and launch at login.
how.label: How
how.title: A minute to set up. A right-click to use.
how.intro: Install the app, enable its Finder extension, then work in your local folders.
how.download.title: Download and move
how.download.body: Download the ZIP, unzip it, and move the app to Applications. Version 1.0.0 still uses the earlier name, MacUtility.app.
how.enable.title: Open and enable
how.enable.body: Open the app. Use its setup prompt, or open Settings from the menu bar and choose Open Finder Extension Settings. Enable its extension there.
how.use.title: Right-click a folder
how.use.body: Right-click empty space inside a Finder folder, or select one folder and right-click. Choose the action you need. New File and New Folder ask for a name; Terminal and path copying run immediately.
how.selection: When a file is selected, actions use its containing folder. Multiple selections are not supported.
how.access: macOS may ask for access to protected folders. Normal filesystem permissions still apply.
help.title: Need a hand?
help.body: If the actions don’t appear, check that the Finder extension is enabled in the app’s Settings. Keep one installed copy of Clicklet to avoid Finder loading an older extension.
download.title: Make Finder a little more useful.
